title: Installation Jobs Permits Office Fee Note: Permit Administration Fee
content:
**Permits office fee note — the permit administration fee on Installation Jobs**

A permitted **Installation Jobs** record is charged the permit administration fee of its installation method, once per permitted job, dated the job's opened date. The figure for each method is the permit administration fee shown in the product's compliance rate sheet, and it is the filing base of the fee.

## How the fee is assembled

1. Any amount added to the fee is added to the filing base, and the filing base and those amounts together form one sum.
2. A filing share of the fee multiplies that whole sum once, never one part of it.
3. The fee is stated in USD and rounded to the nearest cent once, as the last step of its pricing.

## Elements of the charge

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Filing base | the method's permit administration fee |
| Frequency | once per permitted job |
| Date | the job's opened date |
| Rounding | to the nearest cent, as the last step |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A permitted job opened on 4 March under a method whose permit administration fee figure is a hypothetical 110.00 is charged 110.00, once, dated 4 March.

## Points of the note

- **Once per job.** A permitted job carries one permit administration fee; a second fee on the same job is not charged.
- **Which date.** The opened date of the job fixes the date of the fee, whatever day the charge is booked.
- **Which method.** The figure is the one for the installation method named on the job.
